einzeiler: Exploring Jeremiah, Lamentations, and Proverbs with Fr. Mike Schmitz.
kurzfassung: Fr. Mike guides listeners through readings from Jeremiah and Lamentations, connecting biblical sorrow to the pain and evil in today's world. He reflects on how God remains good despite modern desperation, offering ongoing reasons for hope. The episode also includes a reading from Proverbs.
stichpunkte: Reading and discussion of Jeremiah chapters 49 and 50
Exploration of sorrow and pain in Lamentations chapter 3
Reading from Proverbs chapter 18, verses 5 to 8
Connecting biblical themes of suffering to the state of the world today
Reflecting on God's enduring goodness and reasons for hope
beschreibung:
Fr. Mike guides us through another chapter of Jeremiah and connects it to the sorrow and pain we hear in Lamentations. He reminds us that, even with such evil and desperation filing the world these days, God is still good, and we still have reason to hope in him. Today's readings are Jeremiah 49-50, Lamentations 3, and Proverbs 18:5-8.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.
